message.content: According to Lachlan, Cersei could have benefited from a stronger relationship with Tyrion Lannister. Lachlan points out that Tyrion often had a different perspective on power and the family dynamics within the Lannister household. Lachlan suggests that if Cersei had listened to Tyrion and built a closer bond with him, it might have helped her make more rational decisions and potentially avoided some of the harsher choices she made later in the series. This dynamic could have provided Cersei with a more nuanced understanding of power and the importance of alliances and relationships in maintaining stability and influence.
